notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The last returning legendary this season is also one of the first for many. A caster frame in Destiny 2. You won't really be getting a lot of close hits with this so Tireless Blade is the best for at-a-distance fighting. But if you are rough and tumble close, then Relentless Strikes becomes the easy choice. Attrition Orbs is nice if you chuck your heavy in the general direction of enemies to occasionally poop out and orb. Collective Action doesn't work with everything but when it gives you a nice boost you really feel it." Recommended MW: Impact.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Caster frame swords feel like they should belong in the crucible. But it always feels like it's missing something. Either the animation is too long, the tracking is too slow, maybe the damage just isn't tuned right. Valiant Charge will help closing the distance if you use this and heavy attack a second person after lunging. Tireless Blade will give you some ammo back, but there's just something off." Recommended MW: Impact.
